$Comment: Tomas's Apprentice: bake his Christmas treats at a Chef's Stove, and his own loaf recipe opens at his
stall. It is one of the two keys to his secret (Factors/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Tomas_Key.json), the
one that works on every server; a server running MMO Skill Tree also opens the recipe at Crafting level
20. The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_tomas_apprentice, which the key reads once it is
Npc binds it to Tomas by the id his placement keeps in both seasons (Harvest_Feast_Miller), so he offers
it from his Christmas conversation and from his feast conversation's Christmas line, and the base's
Npc.TurnInId adds the report-back step to him. CompletionDialogue plays his Christmas conversation once
it is collected. It opens once his part of Santa's story (christmas_gingerbread_cookies) is done, since
that hands over the cookie recipe. It never repeats: the secret stays open every Christmas after.
The step is CRAFT_ITEM: every Gingerbread Cookie (Target), Hot Cocoa and Christmas Cake (Targets) baked
counts, three to a batch of cookies. Listing.MainLine false keeps it off the story's gold bar.
It pays Christmas Coins and favor on Santa's Nice List and Festival Favor on its own Rewards. The
Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Crafting XP for the baking, waiting to be collected with the rest. Its
own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and
unshown, and the rest still pays. Its words come from the keys its id spells, in christmas.mmo.lang.
Name: Tomas_Apprentice
